package fixture

type syscallController struct{}
type unixController struct{}
type windowsController struct{}

func (syscallController) Exec()          {}
func (syscallController) ForkExec()      {}
func (syscallController) StartProcess()  {}
func (unixController) Exec()             {}
func (unixController) ForkExec()         {}
func (windowsController) CreateProcess() {}

func allowedLowLevelNames(syscall syscallController, unix unixController, windows windowsController) {
	syscall.Exec()
	syscall.ForkExec()
	syscall.StartProcess()
	unix.Exec()
	unix.ForkExec()
	windows.CreateProcess()
}
